description: This file contains multiple PHP functions related to system information and utilities, such as creating bar graphs, executing system commands, formatting byte sizes, reading GIF image heights, and handling errors. It appears to be a collection of common utility functions used in a system info script.

methods.name: created_by
methods.description: Returns an HTML comment string indicating creation info with version.

methods.name: create_bargraph
methods.description: Generates HTML for a bar graph image based on input values and scale.

methods.name: create_bargraph_grad
methods.description: Generates HTML for a gradient bar graph image based on input values.

methods.name: direction
methods.description: Determines text direction (ltr or rtl) and corresponding left/right labels.

methods.name: find_program
methods.description: Finds the full path of an executable program in common system directories.

methods.name: execute_program
methods.description: Executes a system command and returns its output, with error handling.

methods.name: format_bytesize
methods.description: Formats a byte size into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: get_gif_image_height
methods.description: Reads a GIF image file to determine its height.

methods.name: hide_mount
methods.description: Checks if a mount point is in the hidden mounts list.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp into a human-readable uptime string.

methods.name: replace_specialchars
methods.description: Replaces certain special characters in an XML string with ISO-8859-1 equivalents.

methods.name: finddups
methods.description: Finds duplicate entries in an array and annotates their counts.

methods.name: rfts
methods.description: Reads a specified number of lines from a file.

methods.name: gdc
methods.description: Gets directory contents, excluding special entries.
